page.overview:
Who is Kazuyoshi Hoshino?

Kazuyoshi Hoshino (星野 一義 in Japanese) is a former Japanese Formula One driver who competed in the sport from and , driving for Heros Racing.

After racing in Formula One, he returned to race for the Japanese Top Formula Championship and All-Japan GT Championship.
